title: fix: route DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to DeepInfra with Fireworks fallback
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now routes primarily through DeepInfra FP8, with Fireworks as its fallback instead of Fireworks primary and OpenRouter → DeepInfra fallback. Access changes to Paid-only. Input and output prices decrease on a per-million-token basis; cached-input pricing is unchanged. Fireworks fallback costs more than the listed price. Reasoning remains on by default. The catalog no longer advertises parallel_tool_calls, logit_bias, or prediction, though requests using them are still accepted. Primary and forced-fallback paths were verified for text, streaming, vision, tools, prompt caching, provider charges, and wallet pricing.
